events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE

events_summary.content: Move along, girl.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: I saved her! I healed her!

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: I saved the Duchess!
Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: They took my mother's ledger...

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
